A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Rel-MOSS study. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables and appendices are readable, and relocated material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on 12 relational entity-classification tasks, including baseline comparisons, ablations, sensitivity analyses, representation visualizations and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds PR-AUC and ROC-AUC results on four existing tasks in Table 2.

M1.justification: Equation (9) adds Softmax normalization to the scaled query-key scores before multiplication by the value projection. This changes the stated Rel-Gate computation; the remaining architecture, synthesis procedure and objectives are unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether this revises the implementation or corrects its description.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 12 RelBench binary entity-classification tasks. The new ranking evaluation uses the already included f1-driver-top3, f1-driver-dnf, event-user-repeat and event-user-ignore tasks.

E2.justification: The existing comparisons retain their baseline membership. The new ranking table uses RDL, RelGNN and SMOTE, all already evaluated on these tasks; it does not replace or remove comparators from Table 1.

E3.justification: Section 5.5 adds PR-AUC and ROC-AUC evaluation on four existing tasks, supplementing Balanced Accuracy and G-Mean. No changes to the previously reported data splits, training configurations or sample counts are stated.

E4.justification: The component ablations, representation-distance and t-SNE analyses, hyperparameter sweeps and backbone comparisons are retained. The efficiency study moves from Appendix E to Section 5.6 without new analysis; the added AUC table supplies additional benchmark metrics.

E5.justification: Existing mean-and-standard-deviation reporting and figure error bars are unchanged. The new ranking table uses the same plus/minus reporting format, without introducing run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or statistical tests.

E6.justification: New Table 2 reports ranking results, with Rel-MOSS leading all eight task-metric comparisons. For example, its f1-driver-top3 PR-AUC is 0.3571 versus RelGNN's 0.3085, and event-user-ignore PR-AUC is 0.5308 versus SMOTE's 0.5028. These are newly reported comparisons, not improvements over v1 scores; previously reported results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation (9) changes the formal definition of the gating factor through a non-equivalent Softmax operation. Propositions 4.1 and 4.2 and their supporting arguments remain unchanged, as does the complexity analysis relocated from Appendix E to Section 5.6.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty claim, Rel-Gate and Rel-Syn contributions, 12-task scope, and claimed average improvements of up to 2.46% in Balanced Accuracy and 4.00% in G-Mean.

C2.justification: Section 5.5 newly interprets the AUC results as evidence of improved ranking beyond classification at the default threshold and emphasizes PR-AUC's relevance to imbalance. Existing mechanism explanations, efficiency interpretations and limitations are retained.

D1.justification: The Section 5 code-access footnote replaces the anonymous repository link with a named RelMOSS GitHub repository link. Existing implementation details, hyperparameter information and runtime disclosures are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: Citations and bibliography entries for RDF2Vec by Ristoski and Paulheim and GraphSR by Zhou and Gong are removed. The principal research positioning and novelty claims remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds the ranking-evaluation subsection, moves the efficiency discussion into Section 5.6, adds acknowledgements, and makes limited related-work, correspondence and publication-text edits. Most prose and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds ranking-results Table 2 and relocates v1's full-width runtime Table 8 into the main text as compact Table 3. Appendix tables are renumbered and surrounding content reflows; all eight figures retain their content.

improvement.justification: The new ranking evaluation potentially strengthens v1's evidence beyond fixed-threshold classification. However, the added Appendix B.3 explanation reverses the conventional axes of both ROC and precision-recall curves, leaving the calculation underlying the new AUC scores unclear. Equation (9) also changes without explaining its relationship to the unchanged experimental results. These specific uncertainties prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
